RC-DEPENDENCY-001.description: Committed dependency graph cannot be installed or resolved.

RC-TYPE-001.description: Canonical type graph and its consumers are inconsistent.

RC-ROUTER-001.description: Public route or canonical route resolution is inconsistent.

RC-I18N-001.description: Locale, translation, or localized UI contract is inconsistent.

RC-SEO-001.description: Canonical, hreflang, robots, sitemap, or SEO metadata contract is inconsistent.

RC-A11Y-001.description: Accessibility contract is violated in rendered browser output.

RC-RUNTIME-001.description: Browser runtime or console execution contract failed.

RC-NETWORK-001.description: Browser request or network contract failed.

RC-BUILD-001.description: Production build or generated artifact contract failed.

RC-BROWSER-001.description: Browser gate failed without a more specific classified root cause.

RC-UNKNOWN-001.description: Failure could not be assigned to a known root cause.

RC-DIAGNOSTIC-001.description: No gate report was produced; diagnostic evidence is incomplete.

RC-DIAGNOSTIC-002.description: A gate report exists but cannot be parsed as valid JSON.
